title: Extract CSV renderer into its own module
acceptance_criteria: generate_csv and CSV-only helpers live in a focused renderer module.
The generator wrapper preserves the current optional CSV export flow and output filename behavior.
CSV columns and ordering remain unchanged in the first cut unless required for mechanical extraction.
Validation command recorded and runnable: python3 -m py_compile steam_deals_generator.py renderers/common.py renderers/csv_renderer.py
